description:
Lists the instruments of the corporate issuers in the registry (convertible notes, credit facilities, bonds, perpetual preferreds), one row per instrument, as the site's /instruments pages show them: terms, seniority, the yield a holder receives where a last regular-session trade prices it, returns, and the issuer's bitcoin holdings. The holding is the latest-dated figure read from a filing; btc_holdings_derived, beside it, is the last read plus the purchases filed since ("derived from filed purchases"), display only, never in backing_ratio, and confirmed or corrected by the next read. Corporate lending, not bitcoin-backed credit: a holder lends to the issuer unsecured, with no lien on its bitcoin. Income in the returns is what the terms accrue, not what was confirmed paid (returns_convention says so). Prices are IEX's, credited in the answer's attribution. Returns the route's payload as served.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-Co1.
name: get_corporate_instruments
title: Corporate instruments (preferreds and debt)
